description: This file defines various types, constants, and utility functions related to different levels of thinking, verbosity, notices, and other configuration parameters for an AI or reasoning system. It includes functions for normalizing input strings to specific enum values, listing supported levels, and resolving default configurations based on catalog entries.

methods.name: export function isBinaryThinkingProvider(provider?: string | null): boolean { isBinaryThinkingProvider
methods.description: Determines if a given provider supports binary thinking levels (on/off). Always returns false in the current implementation.

methods.name: export function supportsBuiltInXHighThinking( supportsBuiltInXHighThinking
methods.description: Checks if a provider/model combination supports extra high reasoning levels. Always returns false in the current implementation.

methods.name: export function normalizeThinkLevel(raw?: string | null): ThinkLevel | undefined { normalizeThinkLevel
methods.description: Converts a raw string input into a canonical ThinkLevel enum value.

methods.name: export function listThinkingLevels( listThinkingLevels
methods.description: Returns the list of all supported ThinkLevels, which remains constant.

methods.name: export function listThinkingLevelLabels(provider?: string | null, model?: string | null): string/ listThinkingLevelLabels
methods.description: Provides labels for thinking levels, adapting based on whether the provider supports binary levels.

methods.name: export function formatThinkingLevels( formatThinkingLevels
methods.description: Formats the list of thinking level labels into a string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: export function formatXHighModelHint(): string { formatXHighModelHint
methods.description: Returns a hint string indicating models that advertise x-high reasoning.

methods.description: Determines default thinking level based on a catalog entry for a specific provider and model.
